# Prompt&Co.

> AI search optimization agency specializing in AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO
> (Generative Engine Optimization), entity optimization, technical SEO and digital PR.
> Prompt&Co. helps brands become discoverable, understandable, citable and recommendable
> across AI search surfaces including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity,
> Gemini, Copilot and Claude.

Core services: [AI Search Optimization](https://promptco.online/services/ai-search-optimization),
[Answer Engine Optimization](https://promptco.online/services/answer-engine-optimization),
[Generative Engine Optimization](https://promptco.online/services/generative-engine-optimization),
[AI Visibility](https://promptco.online/services/ai-visibility),
[Entity Optimization](https://promptco.online/services/entity-optimization),
[AI Content Optimization](https://promptco.online/services/ai-content-optimization),
[Citation Optimization](https://promptco.online/services/citation-optimization),
[Technical SEO](https://promptco.online/services/technical-seo) and
[Digital PR](https://promptco.online/services/digital-pr).
